Desktop OS.reason: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows VMSwitch driver permits network-based privilege escalation, allowing attackers to gain kernel-level control over virtualized environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows VMSwitch driver permits network-based privilege escalation, allowing attackers to gain kernel-level control over virtualized environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows VMSwitch 驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，使攻击者能够获取虚拟化环境的内核级控制权。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free in Windows Remote Desktop Services enables remote code execution, posing a direct threat to organizations relying on RDP for secure remote access and management.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Remote Desktop Services enables remote code execution, posing a direct threat to organizations relying on RDP for secure remote access and management.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可启用远程代码执行，对依赖 RDP 进行安全远程访问和管理的企业构成直接威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: An integer overflow in the Windows Kernel can lead to local privilege escalation, granting attackers full system control if they can trigger the vulnerable routine through a trusted process.
Desktop OS.reason_en: An integer overflow in the Windows Kernel can lead to local privilege escalation, granting attackers full system control if they can trigger the vulnerable routine through a trusted process.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的整数溢出可能导致本地权限提升，若攻击者能通过受信任进程触发该漏洞例程，即可获得完全的系统控制权。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical remote code execution flaw in Windows RDP allows unauthenticated attackers to take full control of target systems over the network.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical remote code execution flaw in Windows RDP allows unauthenticated attackers to take full control of target systems over the network.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows RDP 中的关键远程代码执行漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过网络完全控制目标系统。

Desktop OS.reason: Race condition in the Windows Server Network driver enables remote code execution without prior authentication, posing severe infrastructure risks.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows Server Network driver enables remote code execution without prior authentication, posing severe infrastructure risks.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Server Network 驱动程序中的竞争条件可在无需预先身份验证的情况下启用远程代码执行，对基础设施构成严重风险。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server service permits unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening network discovery and configuration services.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server service permits unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening network discovery and configuration services.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: DHCP Server 服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，威胁网络发现与配置服务。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper authorization in Active Directory Certificate Services allows privilege escalation and certificate forgery, severely compromising identity management.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper authorization in Active Directory Certificate Services allows privilege escalation and certificate forgery, severely compromising identity management.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的授权不当可导致权限提升和证书伪造，严重破坏身份管理。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Kernel provides a reliable local privilege escalation path affecting virtually all supported Windows versions.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Kernel provides a reliable local privilege escalation path affecting virtually all supported Windows versions.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的释放后使用漏洞提供了一条可靠的本地权限提升路径，影响几乎所有受支持的 Windows 版本。

Desktop OS.reason: Remote Access Connection Manager use-after-free enables network-based privilege escalation through compromised VPN or dial-up connections.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Remote Access Connection Manager use-after-free enables network-based privilege escalation through compromised VPN or dial-up connections.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Access Connection Manager 中的释放后使用漏洞可通过被攻陷的 VPN 或拨号连接实现基于网络的权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Desktop Window Manager heap overflow facilitates local privilege escalation by exploiting the graphics composition subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Desktop Window Manager heap overflow facilitates local privilege escalation by exploiting the graphics composition subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Desktop Window Manager 堆溢出通过利用图形合成子系统促成本地权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Hyper-V heap overflow compromises hypervisor memory isolation, potentially allowing guest-to-host privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Hyper-V heap overflow compromises hypervisor memory isolation, potentially allowing guest-to-host privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Hyper-V 堆溢出破坏了虚拟机监控程序的内存隔离，可能允许客户机到主机的权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Win32K enables local privilege escalation; critical for desktop environments as Win32K handles core GUI operations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Win32K enables local privilege escalation; critical for desktop environments as Win32K handles core GUI operations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Win32K 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可启用本地权限提升；由于 Win32K 处理核心 GUI 操作，该漏洞对桌面环境至关重要。

Desktop OS.reason: Kernel heap overflow allows local privilege escalation; compromises the core operating system layer, potentially leading to full system takeover.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Kernel heap overflow allows local privilege escalation; compromises the core operating system layer, potentially leading to full system takeover.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 内核堆溢出允许本地权限提升；会破坏操作系统核心层，可能导致系统被完全接管。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution over the network, posing a direct threat to administrative access vectors.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution over the network, posing a direct threat to administrative access vectors.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，对管理访问途径构成直接威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Services allows remote privilege escalation, severely impacting multi-user server deployments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Services allows remote privilege escalation, severely impacting multi-user server deployments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程权限提升，严重影响多用户服务器部署。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap overflow in Message Queuing enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, disrupting enterprise messaging infrastructure.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap overflow in Message Queuing enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, disrupting enterprise messaging infrastructure.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Message Queuing 中的堆溢出允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，破坏企业消息传递基础设施。

Desktop OS.reason: WinRT use-after-free vulnerability allows remote privilege escalation over the network, affecting modern Windows application frameworks.
Desktop OS.reason_en: WinRT use-after-free vulnerability allows remote privilege escalation over the network, affecting modern Windows application frameworks.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: WinRT 释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程权限提升，影响现代 Windows 应用程序框架。

Desktop OS.reason: NTFS heap overflow enables local code execution when processing maliciously crafted disk volumes or files, threatening data integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: NTFS heap overflow enables local code execution when processing maliciously crafted disk volumes or files, threatening data integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: NTFS 堆溢出在处理恶意构造的磁盘卷或文件时可启用本地代码执行，威胁数据完整性。

Desktop OS.reason: Untrusted pointer dereference in DirectX allows local code execution via compromised graphics applications or drivers, impacting system stability.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in DirectX allows local code execution via compromised graphics applications or drivers, impacting system stability.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: DirectX 中的不受信任指针解引用允许通过被攻陷的图形应用程序或驱动程序进行本地代码执行，影响系统稳定性。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical kernel-level use-after-free vulnerability with a CVSS of 9.3 that enables unauthorized local privilege escalation, posing a direct threat to endpoint integrity and frequent exploitation in post-exploitation phases.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical kernel-level use-after-free vulnerability with a CVSS of 9.3 that enables unauthorized local privilege escalation, posing a direct threat to endpoint integrity and frequent exploitation in post-exploitation phases.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 一项 CVSS 评分为 9.3 的关键内核级释放后使用漏洞可启用未授权的本地权限提升，对终端完整性构成直接威胁，并在渗透后阶段常被利用。

Desktop OS.reason: High-severity network-accessible heap buffer overflow in GDI+ allowing remote code execution, which attackers frequently leverage for initial compromise and malware delivery across Windows workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: High-severity network-accessible heap buffer overflow in GDI+ allowing remote code execution, which attackers frequently leverage for initial compromise and malware delivery across Windows workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GDI+ 中存在的高危网络可访问堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，攻击者常借此在 Windows 工作站上进行初始入侵和恶意软件投放。

Desktop OS.reason: Remote Desktop Client heap overflow enabling network-based privilege escalation makes this a prime target for adversaries exploiting widely used administrative tools to pivot within corporate networks.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client heap overflow enabling network-based privilege escalation makes this a prime target for adversaries exploiting widely used administrative tools to pivot within corporate networks.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 堆溢出所实现的基于网络权限提升使其成为攻击者的首要目标，后者可利用广泛使用的管理工具在企业网络中进行横向移动。

Desktop OS.reason: A kernel-mode driver use-after-free flaw allows local privilege escalation on Windows systems, impacting nearly all enterprise endpoints.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A kernel-mode driver use-after-free flaw allows local privilege escalation on Windows systems, impacting nearly all enterprise endpoints.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 一种内核模式驱动程序的释放后使用缺陷允许在 Windows 系统上实现本地权限提升，影响几乎所有企业终端。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to remote administration workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to remote administration workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，对远程管理工作流构成严重威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows remote code execution via malicious web content, affecting a widely deployed browser.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows remote code execution via malicious web content, affecting a widely deployed browser.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) 中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过恶意 Web 内容执行远程代码执行，影响广泛部署的浏览器。

Desktop OS.reason: Win32K subsystem use-after-free leads to local privilege escalation, exploiting a core Windows graphics component frequently targeted by malware.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Win32K subsystem use-after-free leads to local privilege escalation, exploiting a core Windows graphics component frequently targeted by malware.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Win32K 子系统释放后使用漏洞会导致本地权限提升，该漏洞利用了经常被恶意软件瞄准的核心 Windows 图形组件。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper input validation in Microsoft Surface firmware/software allows remote code execution, compromising modern hardware ecosystems.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper input validation in Microsoft Surface firmware/software allows remote code execution, compromising modern hardware ecosystems.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Surface 固件/软件中的输入验证不当允许远程代码执行，破坏现代硬件生态系统。

Desktop OS.reason: Local privilege escalation in Windows Secure Kernel Mode allows attackers with limited access to gain elevated system rights. This directly compromises endpoint integrity and enables further lateral movement.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in Windows Secure Kernel Mode allows attackers with limited access to gain elevated system rights. This directly compromises endpoint integrity and enables further lateral movement.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Secure Kernel Mode 中的本地权限提升漏洞允许具有有限访问权限的攻击者获取提权系统权限。这将直接破坏终端完整性并支持进一步的横向移动。

Desktop OS.reason: Flaws in the PassMark DirectIo64.sys kernel driver allow unprivileged users to extract hardcoded keys and perform arbitrary physical memory writes. This undermines OS-level isolation and facilitates credential theft or privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Flaws in the PassMark DirectIo64.sys kernel driver allow unprivileged users to extract hardcoded keys and perform arbitrary physical memory writes. This undermines OS-level isolation and facilitates credential theft or privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: PassMark DirectIo64.sys 内核驱动程序中的缺陷允许无特权用户提取硬编码密钥并执行任意物理内存写入。这会破坏操作系统级别的隔离性，并助长凭据窃取或权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Missing authentication, SSRF, and hardcoded credentials in ASUS Control Center enable unauthorized SSH activation and encryption key extraction. Attackers can easily pivot to manage compromised enterprise endpoints.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Missing authentication, SSRF, and hardcoded credentials in ASUS Control Center enable unauthorized SSH activation and encryption key extraction. Attackers can easily pivot to manage compromised enterprise endpoints.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: ASUS Control Center 中缺失的身份验证、SSRF 漏洞及硬编码凭据可启用未授权的 SSH 激活和加密密钥提取。攻击者可轻松以此为跳板管理已遭攻陷的企业终端。

Desktop OS.reason: Hardcoded credentials in Lightstar SmartIT Desktop Manager enable unauthenticated remote host access, posing severe risks to enterprise endpoint management and patch distribution workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Hardcoded credentials in Lightstar SmartIT Desktop Manager enable unauthenticated remote host access, posing severe risks to enterprise endpoint management and patch distribution workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Lightstar SmartIT Desktop Manager 中的硬编码凭证允许未认证的远程主机访问，对企业终端管理和补丁分发工作流构成严重风险。

Desktop OS.reason: Local privilege escalation in Acunetix's scanning engine allows attackers to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM by exploiting a missing directory path check for OpenSSL-related files.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in Acunetix's scanning engine allows attackers to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM by exploiting a missing directory path check for OpenSSL-related files.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Acunetix 扫描引擎中的本地权限提升漏洞允许攻击者通过利用针对 OpenSSL 相关文件的目录路径检查缺失，以 SYSTEM 身份执行任意代码。

Desktop OS.reason: The excel-mcp-server fails to enforce path confinement when environment variables are unset, allowing unauthenticated users to read and write arbitrary system files on the host machine.
Desktop OS.reason_en: The excel-mcp-server fails to enforce path confinement when environment variables are unset, allowing unauthenticated users to read and write arbitrary system files on the host machine.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 当环境变量未设置时，excel-mcp-server 未能强制执行路径限制，允许未认证用户在宿主机上读取和写入任意系统文件。

Desktop OS.reason: Command injection in Emacs allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands by tricking users into visiting crafted websites or URLs.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Command injection in Emacs allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands by tricking users into visiting crafted websites or URLs.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Emacs 中的命令注入漏洞允许远程攻击者通过诱骗用户访问构造的网站或 URL 来执行任意 Shell 命令。

Desktop OS.reason: A modeline sandbox bypass in Vim enables arbitrary OS command execution when users open specially crafted files, undermining editor security boundaries.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A modeline sandbox bypass in Vim enables arbitrary OS command execution when users open specially crafted files, undermining editor security boundaries.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Vim 中的 modeline 沙箱绕过漏洞使用户在打开特制文件时可执行任意操作系统命令，破坏了编辑器的安全边界。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper CPU cache isolation on AMD Zen 2 processors could allow cross-privilege instruction corruption, potentially leading to local privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper CPU cache isolation on AMD Zen 2 processors could allow cross-privilege instruction corruption, potentially leading to local privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: AMD Zen 2 处理器上的 CPU 缓存隔离不当可能导致跨特权级指令损坏，进而可能引发本地权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Incorrect transmitter electrode assignment in the Synaptics RMI4 driver may cause touchscreen input malfunctions or system instability.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Incorrect transmitter electrode assignment in the Synaptics RMI4 driver may cause touchscreen input malfunctions or system instability.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Synaptics RMI4 驱动中错误的发射极电极分配可能导致触摸屏输入故障或系统不稳定。

Desktop OS.reason: Missing driver data initialization triggers a NULL pointer dereference on suspend, crashing systems using PlayStation SPI controllers.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Missing driver data initialization triggers a NULL pointer dereference on suspend, crashing systems using PlayStation SPI controllers.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 缺少驱动程序数据初始化会在挂起时触发空指针解引用，导致使用 PlayStation SPI 控制器的系统崩溃。

Desktop OS.reason: Absent bounds checking for CRAT subtype lengths allows malformed firmware to trigger out-of-bounds reads in AMDGPU compute drivers.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Absent bounds checking for CRAT subtype lengths allows malformed firmware to trigger out-of-bounds reads in AMDGPU compute drivers.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 对 CRAT 子类型长度缺乏边界检查，使得畸形固件能够在 AMDGPU 计算驱动中触发越界读取。

Desktop OS.reason: Unsigned integer wraparound on zero-length messages causes out-of-bounds memory reads in the DRM logging subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Unsigned integer wraparound on zero-length messages causes out-of-bounds memory reads in the DRM logging subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 零长度消息导致的无符号整数回绕会在 DRM 日志子系统中引发越界内存读取。

Mobile Security.reason: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation, potentially exposing corporate data and AI-generated insights on compromised mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation, potentially exposing corporate data and AI-generated insights on compromised mobile devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: iOS 版 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中的访问控制不当允许未授权权限提升，可能导致已受损移动设备上的企业数据和 AI 生成洞察暴露。

Mobile Security.reason: Untrusted pointer dereference in Microsoft Edge leads to remote code execution, undermining browser isolation and enabling malicious payload delivery on both mobile and desktop clients.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Microsoft Edge leads to remote code execution, undermining browser isolation and enabling malicious payload delivery on both mobile and desktop clients.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的不受信任指针解引用可导致远程代码执行，破坏浏览器隔离机制，并在移动端和桌面端客户端实现恶意载荷投递。

Mobile Security.reason: UI layer spoofing in the Bing App for iOS enables network-based deception attacks, undermining mobile application trust and user safety.
Mobile Security.reason_en: UI layer spoofing in the Bing App for iOS enables network-based deception attacks, undermining mobile application trust and user safety.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: iOS 版 Bing App 中的 UI 层欺骗可实现基于网络的欺骗攻击，破坏移动应用信任并威胁用户安全。

Mobile Security.reason: The Canva Android app improperly exposes sensitive headers to external privileged WebViews, enabling session hijacking. Malicious web contexts can steal active user tokens and impersonate legitimate accounts.
Mobile Security.reason_en: The Canva Android app improperly exposes sensitive headers to external privileged WebViews, enabling session hijacking. Malicious web contexts can steal active user tokens and impersonate legitimate accounts.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Canva Android 应用将敏感头信息不当暴露给外部特权 WebView，从而引发会话劫持。恶意 Web 上下文可窃取活跃用户令牌并冒充合法账户。

Mobile Security.reason: The Canva Android app loads external origins in a privileged WebView, enabling session hijacking and unauthorized communication with the app's native interfaces by controlling the loaded page.
Mobile Security.reason_en: The Canva Android app loads external origins in a privileged WebView, enabling session hijacking and unauthorized communication with the app's native interfaces by controlling the loaded page.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Canva Android 应用在特权 WebView 中加载外部源，通过控制加载的页面实现会话劫持及与应用程序本地接口的未授权通信。

Mobile Security.reason: Unnormalized file paths in Appium MCP server write tools allow attackers to overwrite arbitrary files outside the project root, compromising mobile test environments.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Unnormalized file paths in Appium MCP server write tools allow attackers to overwrite arbitrary files outside the project root, compromising mobile test environments.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Appium MCP 服务器写入工具中的未规范化文件路径允许攻击者覆盖项目根目录之外的任意文件，从而破坏移动测试环境。

IoT Security.reason: Lantronix EDS5000 gateways suffer from command injection via unsanitized usernames in the HTTP RPC module, actively exploited in the wild. Attackers can achieve immediate root-level control over critical industrial edge devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Lantronix EDS5000 gateways suffer from command injection via unsanitized usernames in the HTTP RPC module, actively exploited in the wild. Attackers can achieve immediate root-level control over critical industrial edge devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Lantronix EDS5000 网关的 HTTP RPC 模块因用户名未经过滤而存在命令注入漏洞，且已在实际环境中被积极利用。攻击者可立即获得对关键工业边缘设备的 root 级别控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Tycon Systems monitoring units ship with unconfigured HTTP credentials, leaving the web interface publicly accessible without authentication. This basic misconfiguration grants full administrative access to any network-connected attacker.
IoT Security.reason_en: Tycon Systems monitoring units ship with unconfigured HTTP credentials, leaving the web interface publicly accessible without authentication. This basic misconfiguration grants full administrative access to any network-connected attacker.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Tycon Systems 监控单元出厂时默认未配置 HTTP 凭据，导致 Web 界面无需认证即可公开访问。此基本配置错误使任何联网攻击者都能获得完全的管理员访问权限。

IoT Security.reason: Buffer overflows in MOOS-IvP string decoders trust attacker-controlled length fields, enabling remote code execution on autonomous systems. This poses a severe threat to marine and robotic IoT deployments relying on these protocols.
IoT Security.reason_en: Buffer overflows in MOOS-IvP string decoders trust attacker-controlled length fields, enabling remote code execution on autonomous systems. This poses a severe threat to marine and robotic IoT deployments relying on these protocols.
IoT Security.reason_zh: MOOS-IvP 字符串解码器中的缓冲区溢出漏洞盲目信任攻击者控制的长度字段，可在自主系统上实现远程代码执行。这对依赖这些协议的海上和机器人物联网部署构成严重威胁。

IoT Security.reason: A stack-based buffer overflow in FreeIPMI's BMC data parsing can be triggered by malformed hardware responses, potentially leading to remote code execution on out-of-band management controllers.
IoT Security.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in FreeIPMI's BMC data parsing can be triggered by malformed hardware responses, potentially leading to remote code execution on out-of-band management controllers.
IoT Security.reason_zh: FreeIPMI 的 BMC 数据解析中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可由畸形硬件响应触发，可能导致带外管理控制器上的远程代码执行。

IoT Security.reason: Remote OS command injection in D-Link DNS-320's file sharing CGI endpoint allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands on consumer network-attached storage devices without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in D-Link DNS-320's file sharing CGI endpoint allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands on consumer network-attached storage devices without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_zh: D-Link DNS-320 的文件共享 CGI 端点存在远程操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许攻击者在无需认证的情况下于消费级 NAS 设备上执行任意命令。

IoT Security.reason: Path traversal in the AJCloud IPC firmware's web service permits unauthenticated root-level file reads, severely compromising embedded device integrity and configuration security.
IoT Security.reason_en: Path traversal in the AJCloud IPC firmware's web service permits unauthenticated root-level file reads, severely compromising embedded device integrity and configuration security.
IoT Security.reason_zh: AJCloud IPC 固件的 Web 服务存在路径遍历漏洞，允许未认证的 root 级别文件读取，严重破坏嵌入式设备的完整性与配置安全。

IoT Security.reason: OS command injection in the D-Link DNS-340L CGI handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on vulnerable home NAS devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: OS command injection in the D-Link DNS-340L CGI handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on vulnerable home NAS devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: D-Link DNS-340L 的 CGI 处理程序存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者在易受攻击的家庭 NAS 设备上执行任意命令。

IoT Security.reason: Additional command injection in the Add-On Center component further compromises device integrity by allowing manipulation of installation parameters.
IoT Security.reason_en: Additional command injection in the Add-On Center component further compromises device integrity by allowing manipulation of installation parameters.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Add-On Center 组件中存在的额外命令注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵安装参数，进一步破坏设备完整性。

IoT Security.reason: Uninitialized variable usage in the MediaTek power management driver can cause incorrect frequency scaling or crashes on embedded SoCs.
IoT Security.reason_en: Uninitialized variable usage in the MediaTek power management driver can cause incorrect frequency scaling or crashes on embedded SoCs.
IoT Security.reason_zh: MediaTek 电源管理驱动中使用未初始化变量可能导致嵌入式 SoC 出现错误的频率调节或系统崩溃。

IoT Security.reason: Use-after-free on device tree nodes during bus protection lookup can corrupt kernel memory or crash embedded systems.
IoT Security.reason_en: Use-after-free on device tree nodes during bus protection lookup can corrupt kernel memory or crash embedded systems.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 在总线保护查找过程中对设备树节点的使用后使用漏洞可能损坏内核内存或导致嵌入式系统崩溃。

IoT Security.reason: Incorrect voltage mapping in the FP9931 regulator driver risks hardware damage or system instability in embedded power circuits.
IoT Security.reason_en: Incorrect voltage mapping in the FP9931 regulator driver risks hardware damage or system instability in embedded power circuits.
IoT Security.reason_zh: FP9931 稳压器驱动中错误的电压映射可能导致嵌入式电源电路硬件损坏或系统不稳定。

IoT Security.reason: Asynchronous DMA termination allows use-after-free on TX buffers, potentially corrupting memory or crashing serial drivers.
IoT Security.reason_en: Asynchronous DMA termination allows use-after-free on TX buffers, potentially corrupting memory or crashing serial drivers.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 异步 DMA 终止操作会导致 TX 缓冲区出现使用后使用漏洞，可能损坏内存或导致串行驱动崩溃。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authorization in Azure DNS allows unauthorized privilege escalation, potentially compromising global DNS routing and enabling widespread traffic interception or phishing campaigns.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure DNS allows unauthorized privilege escalation, potentially compromising global DNS routing and enabling widespread traffic interception or phishing campaigns.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure DNS 中缺少授权机制允许未授权权限提升，可能破坏全球 DNS 路由，并支持大规模流量拦截或钓鱼活动。

Cloud Security.reason: Improper access control in Azure App Service enables attackers to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands within isolated web app containers, breaking tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure App Service enables attackers to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands within isolated web app containers, breaking tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure App Service 中的访问控制不当使攻击者能够提升权限并在隔离的 Web 应用容器中执行任意命令，从而破坏租户隔离机制。

Cloud Security.reason: Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB allows remote code execution, directly threatening data integrity and confidentiality across globally distributed NoSQL workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB allows remote code execution, directly threatening data integrity and confidentiality across globally distributed NoSQL workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中的访问控制不当可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁全球分布式 NoSQL 工作负载的数据完整性与机密性。

Cloud Security.reason: Certificate validation failure in the Azure Connected Machine Agent allows adjacent network privilege escalation, undermining hybrid cloud identity verification and device trust models.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Certificate validation failure in the Azure Connected Machine Agent allows adjacent network privilege escalation, undermining hybrid cloud identity verification and device trust models.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Connected Machine Agent 中的证书验证失败可导致相邻网络权限提升，破坏混合云身份验证和设备信任模型。

Cloud Security.reason: Untrusted data deserialization in Azure Active Directory poses a significant risk of service disruption and potential account takeover in enterprise identity and access management environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in Azure Active Directory poses a significant risk of service disruption and potential account takeover in enterprise identity and access management environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的不可信数据反序列化在企业身份与访问管理环境中构成服务中断及潜在账户接管的高风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service grants unauthorized actors full cluster control, representing a critical infrastructure compromise risk.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service grants unauthorized actors full cluster control, representing a critical infrastructure compromise risk.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中缺失的身份认证可使未授权主体获得完整的集群控制权，构成关键基础设施被攻陷的重大风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service allows privilege escalation within identity management pipelines, threatening enterprise SSO architectures.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service allows privilege escalation within identity management pipelines, threatening enterprise SSO architectures.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可在身份管理流水线中实现权限提升，威胁企业单点登录（SSO）架构。

Cloud Security.reason: SSRF vulnerability in Azure OpenAI enables attackers to escalate privileges within AI workloads, highlighting emerging risks in cloud-native machine learning services.
Cloud Security.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Azure OpenAI enables attackers to escalate privileges within AI workloads, highlighting emerging risks in cloud-native machine learning services.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中的 SSRF 漏洞使攻击者能够在 AI 工作负载中提升权限，凸显了云原生机器学习服务的新兴风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift allows privilege escalation, directly impacting container orchestration and multi-tenant cloud deployments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift allows privilege escalation, directly impacting container orchestration and multi-tenant cloud deployments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Red Hat OpenShift 中的授权不当可导致权限提升，直接影响容器编排及多租户云部署。

Cloud Security.reason: Incorrect authorization in Exchange Online facilitates privilege escalation, affecting hybrid cloud email environments and organizational communication channels.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Exchange Online facilitates privilege escalation, affecting hybrid cloud email environments and organizational communication channels.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Exchange Online 中的授权错误可促成权限提升，影响混合云邮件环境及组织通信渠道。

Cloud Security.reason: Azure Active Directory B2C contains an authorization bypass via user-controlled keys, allowing privilege escalation across tenant boundaries. This threatens multi-tenant identity architectures and could lead to widespread account takeover.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Azure Active Directory B2C contains an authorization bypass via user-controlled keys, allowing privilege escalation across tenant boundaries. This threatens multi-tenant identity architectures and could lead to widespread account takeover.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory B2C 存在通过用户可控密钥绕过授权的漏洞，允许跨越租户边界进行权限提升。该漏洞威胁多租户身份架构，并可能导致大规模账户接管。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Language permits unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. Exploitation could compromise cloud AI workloads and associated tenant data.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Language permits unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. Exploitation could compromise cloud AI workloads and associated tenant data.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 中某关键功能缺失身份认证，允许通过网络进行未授权权限提升。利用该漏洞可能危及云 AI 工作负载及相关租户数据。

Cloud Security.reason: The AWS EFS CSI Driver fails to verify storage access point ownership, allowing authenticated Kubernetes users to recursively delete unauthorized directories. This creates significant data loss risks in cloud-native storage orchestration.
Cloud Security.reason_en: The AWS EFS CSI Driver fails to verify storage access point ownership, allowing authenticated Kubernetes users to recursively delete unauthorized directories. This creates significant data loss risks in cloud-native storage orchestration.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: AWS EFS CSI Driver 未能验证存储访问点的所有权，允许已认证的 Kubernetes 用户递归删除未授权目录。这在云原生存储编排中造成严重的数据丢失风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Flawed RBAC scoping in the IBM Instana Agent Operator enables authenticated Kubernetes tenants to hijack or destroy cluster-level permissions, breaking critical multi-tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Flawed RBAC scoping in the IBM Instana Agent Operator enables authenticated Kubernetes tenants to hijack or destroy cluster-level permissions, breaking critical multi-tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: IBM Instana Agent Operator 中缺陷的 RBAC 作用域划分使已认证的 Kubernetes 租户能够劫持或销毁集群级权限，破坏关键的多租户隔离机制。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authorization in Google Cloud Integration Connectors allows authenticated users to attach unauthorized service accounts, leading to full cloud project takeover and lateral movement.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Google Cloud Integration Connectors allows authenticated users to attach unauthorized service accounts, leading to full cloud project takeover and lateral movement.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Google Cloud Integration Connectors 中缺失的授权检查允许已认证用户附加未授权的服务账号，从而导致整个云项目被接管及横向移动。

Cloud Security.reason: Traefik's TLS option conflict resolution flaw allows unauthenticated clients to bypass mutual TLS authentication by exploiting shared router configurations across multi-host setups.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Traefik's TLS option conflict resolution flaw allows unauthenticated clients to bypass mutual TLS authentication by exploiting shared router configurations across multi-host setups.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Traefik 的 TLS 选项冲突解决缺陷允许未认证客户端通过利用多主机配置中共用的路由器配置来绕过双向 TLS 认证。

Cloud Security.reason: Authentication bypass in FastChat's worker registration endpoint lets attackers inject malicious workers and perform SSRF against internal LLM inference services and metadata endpoints.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in FastChat's worker registration endpoint lets attackers inject malicious workers and perform SSRF against internal LLM inference services and metadata endpoints.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: FastChat 的工作节点注册端点存在身份认证绕过漏洞，使攻击者能够注入恶意工作节点并对内部大语言模型推理服务及元数据端点发起 SSRF 攻击。

Cloud Security.reason: Overly permissive ClusterRoleBinding in OpenShift Pipelines grants authenticated users write access to critical Kueue and cert-manager resources.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Overly permissive ClusterRoleBinding in OpenShift Pipelines grants authenticated users write access to critical Kueue and cert-manager resources.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: OpenShift Pipelines 中过于宽松的 ClusterRoleBinding 授予已认证用户对关键 Kueue 和 cert-manager 资源的写入权限。

Cloud Security.reason: Authorization bypass in Azure Cosmos DB enables network spoofing attacks by exploiting user-controlled key management flaws.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure Cosmos DB enables network spoofing attacks by exploiting user-controlled key management flaws.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中的授权绕过漏洞通过利用用户可控的密钥管理缺陷，使得网络欺骗攻击成为可能。

Cloud Security.reason: Unauthenticated attackers can achieve RCE on vLLM servers by publishing malicious HuggingFace models that exploit weak activation function checks.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers can achieve RCE on vLLM servers by publishing malicious HuggingFace models that exploit weak activation function checks.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 未认证的攻击者可通过发布利用激活函数校验薄弱缺陷的恶意 HuggingFace 模型，在 vLLM 服务器上实现远程代码执行（RCE）。

Cloud Security.reason: Insecure binary path resolution during container archive uploads enables potential command injection or arbitrary code execution.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Insecure binary path resolution during container archive uploads enables potential command injection or arbitrary code execution.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 容器归档文件上传期间的不安全二进制路径解析可能导致命令注入或任意代码执行。

Cloud Security.reason: Lenient routing logic in gRPC-Go allows authorization bypass by omitting mandatory path components in HTTP/2 requests.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Lenient routing logic in gRPC-Go allows authorization bypass by omitting mandatory path components in HTTP/2 requests.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: gRPC-Go 中宽松的路由逻辑允许通过在 HTTP/2 请求中省略必需的路径组件来绕过授权。

Cloud Security.reason: Misconfigured TLS secret naming in Traefik enables cross-namespace authentication bypass in Kubernetes ingress controllers.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Misconfigured TLS secret naming in Traefik enables cross-namespace authentication bypass in Kubernetes ingress controllers.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Traefik 中 TLS 密钥命名配置错误可导致 Kubernetes Ingress 控制器出现跨命名空间的身份认证绕过。

Cloud Security.reason: Explicit clearing of KVM MMU role.invalid hardens the hypervisor against virtual machine escapes or crashes.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Explicit clearing of KVM MMU role.invalid hardens the hypervisor against virtual machine escapes or crashes.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 显式清除 KVM MMU 的 role.invalid 标志可增强 Hypervisor 抵御虚拟机逃逸或崩溃的能力。

Cloud Security.reason: Per-process SAML cache limitation allows token replay attacks across Rancher HA clusters, compromising identity federation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Per-process SAML cache limitation allows token replay attacks across Rancher HA clusters, compromising identity federation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 基于进程的 SAML 缓存限制使得跨 Rancher HA 集群的令牌重放攻击成为可能，从而破坏身份联合机制。

Cloud Security.reason: Incomplete command key filtering in n8n's Git node enables repository-based attackers to execute arbitrary commands during workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Incomplete command key filtering in n8n's Git node enables repository-based attackers to execute arbitrary commands during workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: n8n 的 Git 节点中不完整的命令键过滤使得基于仓库的攻击者能够在工作流执行期间运行任意命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Unvalidated namespace interpolation in Nuclio's Docker CLI commands allows attackers to inject and execute arbitrary shell commands.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unvalidated namespace interpolation in Nuclio's Docker CLI commands allows attackers to inject and execute arbitrary shell commands.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Nuclio 的 Docker CLI 命令中存在未经验证的命名空间插值漏洞，使攻击者能够注入并执行任意 Shell 命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Persistent cgroup.procs file descriptors across credential changes enable privilege escalation or container escape.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Persistent cgroup.procs file descriptors across credential changes enable privilege escalation or container escape.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 凭证变更期间 cgroup.procs 文件描述符的持久化可导致权限提升或容器逃逸。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing end-of-options separator in Ansible's git clone commands allows flag injection and code execution during collection installation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing end-of-options separator in Ansible's git clone commands allows flag injection and code execution during collection installation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Ansible 的 git clone 命令中缺失选项结束分隔符，允许在安装集合时进行标志注入并执行代码。

Cloud Security.reason: Crafted Puppet class parameters allow privilege escalation to root on managed hosts, undermining infrastructure-as-code security.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Crafted Puppet class parameters allow privilege escalation to root on managed hosts, undermining infrastructure-as-code security.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 精心构造的 Puppet 类参数允许在受管主机上提升至 root 权限，破坏了基础设施即代码（IaC）的安全性。

Network Devices.reason: Heap buffer overflow in ntop nDPI during TLS SNI and HTTP header parsing can crash network monitoring appliances or enable remote code execution in traffic analysis systems.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in ntop nDPI during TLS SNI and HTTP header parsing can crash network monitoring appliances or enable remote code execution in traffic analysis systems.
Network Devices.reason_zh: ntop nDPI 在解析 TLS SNI 和 HTTP 头部时存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致网络监控设备崩溃或在流量分析系统中实现远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free in the Windows SMB Server Network Transport Driver allows remote code execution over the network, directly impacting file sharing and Active Directory communications.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows SMB Server Network Transport Driver allows remote code execution over the network, directly impacting file sharing and Active Directory communications.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server Network Transport Driver 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，直接影响文件共享及 Active Directory 通信。

Network Devices.reason: Uncontrolled resource consumption in the Windows DHCP Server enables denial-of-service attacks, disrupting IP address allocation and network connectivity for entire subnets.
Network Devices.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in the Windows DHCP Server enables denial-of-service attacks, disrupting IP address allocation and network connectivity for entire subnets.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中不受控的资源消耗可导致拒绝服务攻击，破坏整个子网的 IP 地址分配和网络连接。

Network Devices.reason: DHCP server heap overflow enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising network infrastructure and IP allocation services.
Network Devices.reason_en: DHCP server heap overflow enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising network infrastructure and IP allocation services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP 服务器堆溢出可导致未认证的远程代码执行，直接危及网络基础设施和 IP 分配服务。

Network Devices.reason: DNS service use-after-free allows remote privilege escalation over the network, undermining critical name resolution and directory services.
Network Devices.reason_en: DNS service use-after-free allows remote privilege escalation over the network, undermining critical name resolution and directory services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS 服务的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程权限提升，破坏关键名称解析和目录服务。

Network Devices.reason: RPC API improper authentication permits remote privilege escalation across adjacent networks, bypassing standard security boundaries.
Network Devices.reason_en: RPC API improper authentication permits remote privilege escalation across adjacent networks, bypassing standard security boundaries.
Network Devices.reason_zh: RPC API 身份验证不当允许跨相邻网络进行远程权限提升，绕过标准安全边界。

Network Devices.reason: WinSock path control flaw allows local privilege escalation, potentially bypassing network stack restrictions and firewall policies.
Network Devices.reason_en: WinSock path control flaw allows local privilege escalation, potentially bypassing network stack restrictions and firewall policies.
Network Devices.reason_zh: WinSock 路径控制缺陷可导致本地权限提升，可能绕过网络栈限制和防火墙策略。

Network Devices.reason: Windows Filtering Platform access control weakness enables local privilege escalation, risking unauthorized bypass of network traffic filtering.
Network Devices.reason_en: Windows Filtering Platform access control weakness enables local privilege escalation, risking unauthorized bypass of network traffic filtering.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows Filtering Platform 访问控制弱点可导致本地权限提升，存在未经授权绕过网络流量过滤的风险。

Network Devices.reason: Authentication bypass in the SMB server protocol allows network-based privilege escalation, directly impacting internal network security and facilitating rapid ransomware propagation.
Network Devices.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the SMB server protocol allows network-based privilege escalation, directly impacting internal network security and facilitating rapid ransomware propagation.
Network Devices.reason_zh: SMB 服务器协议中的身份验证绕过允许基于网络的权限提升，直接影响内网安全并加速勒索软件传播。

Network Devices.reason: Adjacent network heap buffer overflow in the DHCP server can lead to remote code execution, threatening network infrastructure, IP allocation services, and connected devices.
Network Devices.reason_en: Adjacent network heap buffer overflow in the DHCP server can lead to remote code execution, threatening network infrastructure, IP allocation services, and connected devices.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP 服务器的相邻网络堆缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，威胁网络基础设施、IP 分配服务及已连接设备。

Network Devices.reason: HTTP.sys resource exhaustion flaw enables denial-of-service attacks against web servers and network proxies, disrupting critical online services and enterprise connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_en: HTTP.sys resource exhaustion flaw enables denial-of-service attacks against web servers and network proxies, disrupting critical online services and enterprise connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 资源耗尽缺陷可导致针对 Web 服务器和网络代理的拒绝服务攻击，破坏关键在线服务和企业网络连接。

Network Devices.reason: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack enables remote code execution over adjacent networks, destabilizing core networking infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack enables remote code execution over adjacent networks, destabilizing core networking infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的竞争条件可导致通过相邻网络进行远程代码执行，破坏核心网络基础设施的稳定性。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote code execution, jeopardizing critical domain resolution services essential for network operations.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote code execution, jeopardizing critical domain resolution services essential for network operations.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及网络运行所必需的关键域名解析服务。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free in the Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) driver permits remote code execution, compromising enterprise VPN and tunneling solutions.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) driver permits remote code execution, compromising enterprise VPN and tunneling solutions.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) 驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及企业 VPN 和隧道解决方案。

Network Devices.reason: Integer underflow in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver enables remote code execution, impacting multicast routing and streaming services.
Network Devices.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver enables remote code execution, impacting multicast routing and streaming services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Reliable Multicast Transport Driver 中的整数下溢可导致远程代码执行，影响多播路由和流媒体服务。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services allows remote code execution, threatening foundational directory and authentication services.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services allows remote code execution, threatening foundational directory and authentication services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，威胁基础目录和身份验证服务。

Network Devices.reason: ntopng network monitoring tools fail to validate user privileges on bulk-delete endpoints, allowing non-administrators to destroy host pools. This blinds network visibility and disrupts traffic analysis capabilities.
Network Devices.reason_en: ntopng network monitoring tools fail to validate user privileges on bulk-delete endpoints, allowing non-administrators to destroy host pools. This blinds network visibility and disrupts traffic analysis capabilities.
Network Devices.reason_zh: ntopng 网络监控工具在批量删除端点上未验证用户权限，导致非管理员可销毁主机池。这将导致网络可视性丧失并破坏流量分析能力。

Network Devices.reason: A stack buffer overflow in TP-Link Archer AX55's EasyMesh daemon enables remote code execution for LAN attackers. Compromising router firmware grants control over entire home or branch office networks.
Network Devices.reason_en: A stack buffer overflow in TP-Link Archer AX55's EasyMesh daemon enables remote code execution for LAN attackers. Compromising router firmware grants control over entire home or branch office networks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: TP-Link Archer AX55 的 EasyMesh 守护进程中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可使局域网攻击者实现远程代码执行。攻破路由器固件将赋予对家庭或分支机构网络的完全控制权。

Network Devices.reason: FreeIPMI suffers from a stack-based buffer overflow when processing malformed Fujitsu SEL responses, potentially crashing out-of-band management controllers. This jeopardizes hardware-level monitoring and recovery mechanisms.
Network Devices.reason_en: FreeIPMI suffers from a stack-based buffer overflow when processing malformed Fujitsu SEL responses, potentially crashing out-of-band management controllers. This jeopardizes hardware-level monitoring and recovery mechanisms.
Network Devices.reason_zh: FreeIPMI 在处理格式错误的 Fujitsu SEL 响应时存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致带外管理控制器崩溃。这将危及硬件级监控和恢复机制。

Network Devices.reason: Stack buffer overflow in PJSIP's SRTP/SDES media transport processing during SDP negotiation can crash or execute code in widely deployed VoIP gateways and SIP proxy servers.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in PJSIP's SRTP/SDES media transport processing during SDP negotiation can crash or execute code in widely deployed VoIP gateways and SIP proxy servers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: PJSIP 在 SDP 协商期间处理 SRTP/SDES 媒体传输时的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致广泛部署的 VoIP 网关和 SIP 代理服务器崩溃或执行恶意代码。

Network Devices.reason: Stack overflow in PJSUA's Service-Route header handling during SIP registration responses exposes multimedia communication stacks to remote exploitation and session hijacking.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack overflow in PJSUA's Service-Route header handling during SIP registration responses exposes multimedia communication stacks to remote exploitation and session hijacking.
Network Devices.reason_zh: PJSUA 在处理 SIP 注册响应中的 Service-Route 头部时存在栈溢出漏洞，使多媒体通信栈面临远程利用和会话劫持风险。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Red Hat Corosync's TotemPG multicast reassembly lacks runtime bounds checking, risking denial of service or code execution in clustered network environments.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Red Hat Corosync's TotemPG multicast reassembly lacks runtime bounds checking, risking denial of service or code execution in clustered network environments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Red Hat Corosync 的 TotemPG 多播重组功能中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，且缺乏运行时边界检查，在集群网络环境中可能导致拒绝服务或代码执行风险。

Network Devices.reason: Critical vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR software affects enterprise routing infrastructure, requiring immediate patching to prevent potential network disruption.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR software affects enterprise routing infrastructure, requiring immediate patching to prevent potential network disruption.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Cisco IOS XR 软件中的高危漏洞影响企业路由基础设施，需立即修补以防止潜在的网络中断。

Network Devices.reason: Netty's failure to validate DNS CNAME record origins enables cache poisoning attacks within applications relying on the framework.
Network Devices.reason_en: Netty's failure to validate DNS CNAME record origins enables cache poisoning attacks within applications relying on the framework.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Netty 未能验证 DNS CNAME 记录来源，使得依赖该框架的应用程序易受缓存投毒攻击。

Network Devices.reason: Out-of-bounds read in the Linux CIFS client during path sanitization could expose kernel memory when processing malformed SMB paths.
Network Devices.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Linux CIFS client during path sanitization could expose kernel memory when processing malformed SMB paths.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Linux CIFS 客户端在进行路径清理时存在越界读取漏洞，在处理格式错误的 SMB 路径时可能泄露内核内存。

Network Devices.reason: Samba retrieves CA certificates over unencrypted HTTP during auto-enrollment, enabling MITM attacks and trust store poisoning.
Network Devices.reason_en: Samba retrieves CA certificates over unencrypted HTTP during auto-enrollment, enabling MITM attacks and trust store poisoning.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Samba 在自动注册过程中通过未加密的 HTTP 检索 CA 证书，易受中间人攻击和信任存储投毒。

Network Devices.reason: Maliciously crafted DNS zones cause excessive CPU consumption on BIND resolvers, leading to widespread denial of service.
Network Devices.reason_en: Maliciously crafted DNS zones cause excessive CPU consumption on BIND resolvers, leading to widespread denial of service.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 恶意构造的 DNS 区域会导致 BIND 解析器 CPU 消耗过高，引发大规模拒绝服务。

Network Devices.reason: Integer underflow during GnuTLS DTLS reassembly triggers remotely exploitable out-of-bounds reads, risking information disclosure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Integer underflow during GnuTLS DTLS reassembly triggers remotely exploitable out-of-bounds reads, risking information disclosure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: GnuTLS DTLS 重组过程中的整数下溢会触发可远程利用的越界读取，存在信息泄露风险。

Network Devices.reason: Improper username matching in GnuTLS RSA-PSK configurations allows remote authentication bypass on TLS servers.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper username matching in GnuTLS RSA-PSK configurations allows remote authentication bypass on TLS servers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: GnuTLS RSA-PSK 配置中的用户名匹配不当允许对 TLS 服务器进行远程身份验证绕过。

Network Devices.reason: Improper validation of BIG TCP aggregation criteria in the Linux network stack can cause packet corruption or crashes.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper validation of BIG TCP aggregation criteria in the Linux network stack can cause packet corruption or crashes.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Linux 网络栈中对 BIG TCP 聚合条件的验证不当可能导致数据包损坏或系统崩溃。

Network Devices.reason: Hostname concatenation into shell commands during LibreNMS libvirt discovery enables authenticated remote code execution.
Network Devices.reason_en: Hostname concatenation into shell commands during LibreNMS libvirt discovery enables authenticated remote code execution.
Network Devices.reason_zh: LibreNMS 在 libvirt 发现过程中将主机名拼接至 Shell 命令中，可导致经过身份验证的远程代码执行。

Industrial Control.reason: Inductive Automation Ignition SCADA platforms ship with blank project creation role settings, permitting authenticated users to execute arbitrary gateway scripts. This bypasses operational security controls and risks production environment manipulation.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Inductive Automation Ignition SCADA platforms ship with blank project creation role settings, permitting authenticated users to execute arbitrary gateway scripts. This bypasses operational security controls and risks production environment manipulation.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Inductive Automation Ignition SCADA 平台默认项目创建角色设置为空，允许经过身份验证的用户执行任意网关脚本。此举绕过了操作安全控制，并存在生产环境被篡改的风险。

Industrial Control.reason: The NetStaX EtherNet/IP Stack lacks proper receive buffer validation, allowing oversized requests to cause memory corruption or device crashes. This threatens PLC communication stability and enables potential remote exploitation on factory floors.
Industrial Control.reason_en: The NetStaX EtherNet/IP Stack lacks proper receive buffer validation, allowing oversized requests to cause memory corruption or device crashes. This threatens PLC communication stability and enables potential remote exploitation on factory floors.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: NetStaX EtherNet/IP 协议栈缺乏适当的接收缓冲区验证，允许超大请求导致内存损坏或设备崩溃。这威胁到 PLC 通信的稳定性，并可能在工厂车间实现潜在的远程利用。

Industrial Control.reason: PALLET CONTROL products contain incorrect default permissions that allow local attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. Misconfigured access controls directly endanger automated manufacturing hardware.
Industrial Control.reason_en: PALLET CONTROL products contain incorrect default permissions that allow local attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. Misconfigured access controls directly endanger automated manufacturing hardware.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: PALLET CONTROL 产品包含不正确的默认权限，允许本地攻击者以 SYSTEM 权限执行任意代码。访问控制配置不当直接危及自动化制造硬件。

Industrial Control.reason: Unsanitized text passed to shell commands in MOOS-IvP's iSay variable handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on autonomous vehicle and marine control networks.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Unsanitized text passed to shell commands in MOOS-IvP's iSay variable handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on autonomous vehicle and marine control networks.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: MOOS-IvP 的 iSay 变量处理程序将未过滤文本传递给 shell 命令，允许远程攻击者在自动驾驶车辆和海洋控制网络上执行任意命令。

Industrial Control.reason: Authentication bypass in MOOS pShare accepts UDP datagrams from any source, enabling message injection and identity spoofing in industrial telemetry and sensor buses.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Authentication bypass in MOOS pShare accepts UDP datagrams from any source, enabling message injection and identity spoofing in industrial telemetry and sensor buses.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: MOOS pShare 中的身份验证绕过漏洞接受来自任何源头的 UDP 数据报，从而在工业遥测和传感器总线上实现消息注入和身份伪造。

Industrial Control.reason: Pre-authentication heap overflow in MOOSCommPkt packet handling allows remote attackers to write arbitrary memory by exploiting signed integer conversion flaws in packet length validation.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Pre-authentication heap overflow in MOOSCommPkt packet handling allows remote attackers to write arbitrary memory by exploiting signed integer conversion flaws in packet length validation.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: MOOSCommPkt 数据包处理中的预认证堆溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过利用数据包长度验证中的有符号整数转换缺陷来写入任意内存。

Industrial Control.reason: Shell command injection in MOOS-IvP uMemWatch allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via unsanitized client names in underwater robotics systems.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Shell command injection in MOOS-IvP uMemWatch allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via unsanitized client names in underwater robotics systems.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: MOOS-IvP uMemWatch 中的 shell 命令注入漏洞允许攻击者通过水下机器人系统中未过滤的客户端名称执行任意命令。

Industrial Control.reason: Unauthenticated UDP packet injection in pMOOSBridge compromises data integrity by allowing spoofed variable injection into the local control community.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Unauthenticated UDP packet injection in pMOOSBridge compromises data integrity by allowing spoofed variable injection into the local control community.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: pMOOSBridge 中的未授权 UDP 数据包注入漏洞允许向本地控制社区注入伪造变量，从而破坏数据完整性。

Industrial Control.reason: Missing negative length validation in core-moos triggers unhandled exceptions, causing denial of service in critical mission databases.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Missing negative length validation in core-moos triggers unhandled exceptions, causing denial of service in critical mission databases.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: core-moos 中缺失负长度验证会触发未处理的异常，导致关键任务数据库发生拒绝服务。

Industrial Control.reason: Stack-based buffer over-read in FreeIPMI's Fujitsu OEM parsing can leak sensitive BMC sensor data or crash management tools.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Stack-based buffer over-read in FreeIPMI's Fujitsu OEM parsing can leak sensitive BMC sensor data or crash management tools.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: FreeIPMI 的 Fujitsu OEM 解析中存在基于栈的缓冲区越界读取漏洞，可能导致敏感 BMC 传感器数据泄露或管理工具崩溃。

Industrial Control.reason: Uncontrolled write during Dell system info retrieval triggers a stack overflow, enabling remote code execution in IPMI utilities.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Uncontrolled write during Dell system info retrieval triggers a stack overflow, enabling remote code execution in IPMI utilities.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Dell 系统信息检索期间的非受控写入会触发栈溢出，从而在 IPMI 实用程序中实现远程代码执行。

Industrial Control.reason: Similar critical stack overflow in iDRAC info parsing allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted IPMI responses.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Similar critical stack overflow in iDRAC info parsing allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted IPMI responses.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: iDRAC 信息解析中类似的严重栈溢出漏洞允许攻击者通过构造的 IPMI 响应执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Authenticated PHP object injection in YesWiki allows remote code execution, compromising wiki instances and potentially leading to full server takeover via serialized payloads.
Web Security.reason_en: Authenticated PHP object injection in YesWiki allows remote code execution, compromising wiki instances and potentially leading to full server takeover via serialized payloads.
Web Security.reason_zh: YesWiki 中的已认证 PHP 对象注入漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及 Wiki 实例，并可能通过序列化有效载荷导致服务器完全沦陷。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in YesWiki’s ReactionManager permits authenticated users to manipulate database queries, risking data exfiltration, modification, and administrative account compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in YesWiki’s ReactionManager permits authenticated users to manipulate database queries, risking data exfiltration, modification, and administrative account compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: YesWiki 的 ReactionManager 中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已认证用户操纵数据库查询，面临数据外泄、篡改及管理账户被攻陷的风险。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Edge enables attackers to spoof internal services or exfiltrate sensitive data from restricted networks accessed via the browser.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Edge enables attackers to spoof internal services or exfiltrate sensitive data from restricted networks accessed via the browser.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的服务端请求伪造漏洞使攻击者能够伪造内部服务，或通过浏览器访问受限网络以窃取敏感数据。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), this SharePoint weak authentication flaw allows unauthorized access to sensitive web portals and documents.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), this SharePoint weak authentication flaw allows unauthorized access to sensitive web portals and documents.
Web Security.reason_zh: 该 SharePoint 弱身份验证漏洞已在野外被积极利用（列入 CISA KEV），允许未经授权访问敏感 Web 门户和文档。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization controls in SharePoint enable authenticated users to escalate privileges and access restricted web resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization controls in SharePoint enable authenticated users to escalate privileges and access restricted web resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失的授权控制允许已认证用户提升权限并访问受限 Web 资源。

Web Security.reason: Injection vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio bypasses security features, targeting developer toolchains and AI-assisted coding environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio bypasses security features, targeting developer toolchains and AI-assisted coding environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 和 Visual Studio 中的注入漏洞绕过了安全功能，针对开发者工具链和 AI 辅助编码环境。

Web Security.reason: Infinite loop in Active Directory Federation Services causes denial-of-service, disrupting enterprise single sign-on and web application authentication.
Web Security.reason_en: Infinite loop in Active Directory Federation Services causes denial-of-service, disrupting enterprise single sign-on and web application authentication.
Web Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的无限循环会导致拒绝服务，破坏企业单点登录和 Web 应用程序身份验证。

Web Security.reason: Incorrect authorization in .NET allows network attackers to bypass security features, impacting web APIs and internet-facing applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in .NET allows network attackers to bypass security features, impacting web APIs and internet-facing applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET 中的错误授权允许网络攻击者绕过安全功能，影响 Web API 和面向互联网的应用程序。

Web Security.reason: Type confusion in Windows OLE is frequently weaponized via malicious web documents or emails to achieve remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Type confusion in Windows OLE is frequently weaponized via malicious web documents or emails to achieve remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: Windows OLE 中的类型混淆漏洞常被武器化，通过恶意 Web 文档或电子邮件实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: AD FS stack buffer overflow enables remote denial of service, disrupting single sign-on and federated identity management for web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: AD FS stack buffer overflow enables remote denial of service, disrupting single sign-on and federated identity management for web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: AD FS 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程拒绝服务，破坏 Web 应用程序的单点登录和联合身份管理。

Web Security.reason: .NET Framework stack buffer overflow allows remote denial of service, impacting web servers and cloud-hosted .NET applications.
Web Security.reason_en: .NET Framework stack buffer overflow allows remote denial of service, impacting web servers and cloud-hosted .NET applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET Framework 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程拒绝服务，影响 Web 服务器和云托管的 .NET 应用程序。

Web Security.reason: WPAD heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, compromising web proxy auto-discovery mechanisms used in corporate networks.
Web Security.reason_en: WPAD heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, compromising web proxy auto-discovery mechanisms used in corporate networks.
Web Security.reason_zh: WPAD 堆溢出漏洞可实现本地权限提升，破坏企业网络中使用的 Web 代理自动发现机制。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited in the wild according to CISA KEV, this SharePoint deserialization flaw enables remote code execution, demanding immediate patching to prevent widespread enterprise compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild according to CISA KEV, this SharePoint deserialization flaw enables remote code execution, demanding immediate patching to prevent widespread enterprise compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: 根据 CISA KEV，此 SharePoint 反序列化漏洞已在野外被积极利用，可实现远程代码执行，亟需立即修补以防止企业范围的大规模沦陷。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Power BI allows attackers to perform credential spoofing and session hijacking against business intelligence users accessing sensitive dashboards.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Power BI allows attackers to perform credential spoofing and session hijacking against business intelligence users accessing sensitive dashboards.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power BI 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者对访问敏感仪表板的商业智能用户进行凭据伪造和会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in .NET compromises application integrity checks, enabling malicious code execution across a wide range of web frameworks and desktop applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in .NET compromises application integrity checks, enabling malicious code execution across a wide range of web frameworks and desktop applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET 中的加密签名验证绕过漏洞破坏了应用程序完整性检查，使得恶意代码能够在广泛的 Web 框架和桌面应用程序中执行。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution and is already listed in CISA KEV, confirming active exploitation in the wild.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution and is already listed in CISA KEV, confirming active exploitation in the wild.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可实现远程代码执行，且已列入 CISA KEV，证实了其在野外的积极利用。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass via assumed-immutable data in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation, undermining web application security controls.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass via assumed-immutable data in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation, undermining web application security controls.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中通过假设不可变数据进行身份验证绕过可实现权限提升，削弱 Web 应用程序的安全控制。

Web Security.reason: Open redirect vulnerability in M365 Copilot enables privilege escalation through untrusted site redirection, affecting cloud productivity suites.
Web Security.reason_en: Open redirect vulnerability in M365 Copilot enables privilege escalation through untrusted site redirection, affecting cloud productivity suites.
Web Security.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 中的开放重定向漏洞通过不受信任的网站重定向实现权限提升，影响云生产力套件。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates spoofing and data theft, leveraging a widely deployed enterprise mail and web platform.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates spoofing and data theft, leveraging a widely deployed enterprise mail and web platform.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞利用广泛部署的企业邮件和 Web 平台，助长伪造和数据窃取行为。

Web Security.reason: CRLF injection in Laravel email validation combined with Symfony Mailer handling may interfere with outbound emails, impacting PHP-based web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: CRLF injection in Laravel email validation combined with Symfony Mailer handling may interfere with outbound emails, impacting PHP-based web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: Laravel邮箱验证中的CRLF注入结合Symfony Mailer处理机制可能干扰出站邮件，影响基于PHP的Web应用程序。

Web Security.reason: Command injection in Microsoft Edge's Copilot Chat extension allows unauthorized network-based code execution. Browser-integrated extensions provide high-impact attack surfaces for compromising user workstations.
Web Security.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Edge's Copilot Chat extension allows unauthorized network-based code execution. Browser-integrated extensions provide high-impact attack surfaces for compromising user workstations.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge的Copilot Chat扩展中存在命令注入漏洞，允许未经授权的基于网络的代码执行。浏览器内置扩展为攻陷用户工作站提供了高影响的攻击面。

Web Security.reason: Next.js inconsistently escapes backslashes in route segments on Windows, leading to path construction vulnerabilities. This affects modern React-based web applications and can facilitate directory traversal or injection attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Next.js inconsistently escapes backslashes in route segments on Windows, leading to path construction vulnerabilities. This affects modern React-based web applications and can facilitate directory traversal or injection attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Next.js在Windows系统的路由段中对反斜杠的转义不一致，导致路径构造漏洞。该问题影响现代基于React的Web应用程序，并可能助长目录遍历或注入攻击。

Web Security.reason: The ACPT WordPress plugin lacks authorization checks in its submission function, enabling unauthenticated privilege escalation. Attackers can manipulate target user IDs to take over administrative accounts on vulnerable sites.
Web Security.reason_en: The ACPT WordPress plugin lacks authorization checks in its submission function, enabling unauthenticated privilege escalation. Attackers can manipulate target user IDs to take over administrative accounts on vulnerable sites.
Web Security.reason_zh: ACPT WordPress插件在其提交函数中缺乏授权检查，可导致未授权提权。攻击者可操纵目标用户ID以接管易受攻击站点上的管理员账户。

Web Security.reason: The AI Website Builder WordPress plugin lacks authorization checks on REST API routes, enabling unauthenticated attackers to install plugins, import content, and achieve full site compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: The AI Website Builder WordPress plugin lacks authorization checks on REST API routes, enabling unauthenticated attackers to install plugins, import content, and achieve full site compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: AI Website Builder WordPress插件在REST API路由上缺乏授权检查，使未认证攻击者能够安装插件、导入内容并实现全站沦陷。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in ILIAS via the LTI authentication endpoint triggers deserialization chains that lead to remote code execution on e-learning platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in ILIAS via the LTI authentication endpoint triggers deserialization chains that lead to remote code execution on e-learning platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过LTI认证端点在ILIAS中存在的未认证PHP对象注入会触发反序列化链，从而导致在线学习平台上的远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: TEN Framework's unauthenticated file-content API endpoints allow arbitrary file reads and writes, critically impacting AI-driven web application deployments and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_en: TEN Framework's unauthenticated file-content API endpoints allow arbitrary file reads and writes, critically impacting AI-driven web application deployments and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_zh: TEN Framework的未认证file-content API端点允许任意文件读写，严重危及AI驱动的Web应用部署及数据机密性。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal in the marker FastAPI upload handler fails to sanitize filenames, permitting unauthenticated attackers to overwrite or delete arbitrary system files via crafted uploads.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal in the marker FastAPI upload handler fails to sanitize filenames, permitting unauthenticated attackers to overwrite or delete arbitrary system files via crafted uploads.
Web Security.reason_zh: marker FastAPI上传处理器存在路径遍历漏洞，未能对文件名进行有效过滤，致使未认证攻击者可通过精心构造的上传覆盖或删除任意系统文件。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in Traefik's digestAuth middleware occurs when unknown usernames receive empty secrets, enabling unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Traefik's digestAuth middleware occurs when unknown usernames receive empty secrets, enabling unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_zh: 当Traefik的digestAuth中间件接收到未知用户名且密钥为空时，会发生身份验证绕过，从而导致未授权访问。

Web Security.reason: IDOR vulnerabilities in Blinko's tRPC procedures allow unauthorized users to manipulate and delete messages across conversations.
Web Security.reason_en: IDOR vulnerabilities in Blinko's tRPC procedures allow unauthorized users to manipulate and delete messages across conversations.
Web Security.reason_zh: Blinko的tRPC过程存在IDOR漏洞，允许未授权用户跨会话篡改和删除消息。

Web Security.reason: Stacked SQL injection in R2R's vector index creation endpoint permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries.
Web Security.reason_en: Stacked SQL injection in R2R's vector index creation endpoint permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries.
Web Security.reason_zh: R2R的向量索引创建端点存在堆叠SQL注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者执行任意数据库查询。

Web Security.reason: Header injection via unsanitized form-data arguments enables request smuggling and security policy evasion in web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Header injection via unsanitized form-data arguments enables request smuggling and security policy evasion in web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过未清理的表单数据参数引发的HTTP头注入可导致Web应用程序的请求走私及安全策略绕过。

Web Security.reason: Compiling pre-parsed AST objects in Handlebars directly emits values into JavaScript, enabling high-severity client-side template injection.
Web Security.reason_en: Compiling pre-parsed AST objects in Handlebars directly emits values into JavaScript, enabling high-severity client-side template injection.
Web Security.reason_zh: 在Handlebars中编译预解析的AST对象会直接将值输出至JavaScript，从而引发高危客户端模板注入。

Web Security.reason: Critical sandbox escape in Node.js vm2 allows attackers to break out of isolated environments and execute code on the host.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical sandbox escape in Node.js vm2 allows attackers to break out of isolated environments and execute code on the host.
Web Security.reason_zh: Node.js vm2中存在关键沙箱逃逸漏洞，允许攻击者突破隔离环境并在宿主机上执行代码。

Web Security.reason: Mutable proxy bridge forwards sandbox writes to real host prototypes, enabling full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Mutable proxy bridge forwards sandbox writes to real host prototypes, enabling full system compromise.

Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unrestricted resource allocation in the .NET Framework threatens the availability of web services and database connectivity layers.

Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Identical deserialization flaw in SQL Server enables remote code execution, posing a severe risk to data-tier availability and confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在相同的反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，对数据层的可用性和机密性构成严重风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: External control of file path in SQL Server allows privilege escalation, affecting database storage and backup operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: External control of file path in SQL Server allows privilege escalation, affecting database storage and backup operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的文件路径外部控制漏洞可导致权限提升，影响数据库存储和备份操作。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server enables remote code execution, impacting mail server middleware and message processing pipelines.

Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SQL Server ODBC driver allows remote code execution, threatening database connectivity layers and client applications.
