Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL Server contains an SQL injection flaw that allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This directly compromises database integrity and exposes sensitive stored data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL Server contains an SQL injection flaw that allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This directly compromises database integrity and exposes sensitive stored data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过网络提升权限。该漏洞直接破坏数据库完整性并暴露敏感存储数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Red Hat Undertow fails to properly validate Host headers, enabling request smuggling and SSRF in widely deployed Java application servers. This undermines web proxy security and backend service isolation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Red Hat Undertow fails to properly validate Host headers, enabling request smuggling and SSRF in widely deployed Java application servers. This undermines web proxy security and backend service isolation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Red Hat Undertow 未能正确验证 Host 头，导致在广泛部署的 Java 应用服务器中发生请求走私和 SSRF 漏洞。这破坏了 Web 代理安全性和后端服务隔离性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: IBM Netezza ships with hardcoded container registry credentials, exposing private images and proprietary configurations. Attackers can leverage these secrets to pull sensitive artifacts or tamper with deployment pipelines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: IBM Netezza ships with hardcoded container registry credentials, exposing private images and proprietary configurations. Attackers can leverage these secrets to pull sensitive artifacts or tamper with deployment pipelines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: IBM Netezza 默认携带硬编码的容器注册表凭据，暴露了私有镜像和专有配置。攻击者可利用这些密钥拉取敏感制品或篡改部署流水线。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Exposed unauthenticated /worker/deployContainer endpoint in PowerJob Worker versions enables remote code execution on distributed task scheduling platforms without any credentials.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Exposed unauthenticated /worker/deployContainer endpoint in PowerJob Worker versions enables remote code execution on distributed task scheduling platforms without any credentials.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: PowerJob Worker 版本中暴露的未认证 /worker/deployContainer 端点可在无需任何凭据的情况下在分布式任务调度平台上实现远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Predictable JWT signing key in PowerJob Server allows token forgery, granting attackers full administrative control and the ability to manipulate scheduled jobs across the middleware.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Predictable JWT signing key in PowerJob Server allows token forgery, granting attackers full administrative control and the ability to manipulate scheduled jobs across the middleware.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: PowerJob Server 中可预测的 JWT 签名密钥允许令牌伪造，使攻击者获得完全的管理控制权，并能跨中间件操纵计划任务。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Restricted-mode bypass in Postgres MCP Pro allows execution of file-reading functions via FROM-clause syntax, circumventing database security policies and exposing sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Restricted-mode bypass in Postgres MCP Pro allows execution of file-reading functions via FROM-clause syntax, circumventing database security policies and exposing sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Postgres MCP Pro 中的受限模式绕过漏洞允许通过 FROM 子句语法执行文件读取函数，从而规避数据库安全策略并暴露敏感数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unbounded HNSW index parameters in Chroma vector databases enable unauthenticated denial of service through excessive memory allocation during index compaction operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unbounded HNSW index parameters in Chroma vector databases enable unauthenticated denial of service through excessive memory allocation during index compaction operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Chroma 向量数据库中未限制的 HNSW 索引参数可通过索引压缩操作期间的过度内存分配导致未认证的拒绝服务攻击。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Undertow's mishandling of chunked responses leads to uncontrolled resource consumption, causing denial of service conditions.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Undertow's mishandling of chunked responses leads to uncontrolled resource consumption, causing denial of service conditions.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Undertow 对分块响应处理不当会导致资源消耗失控，引发拒绝服务状况。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Missing decoded length validation in Prometheus' snappy-compressed requests allows unauthenticated memory exhaustion attacks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Missing decoded length validation in Prometheus' snappy-compressed requests allows unauthenticated memory exhaustion attacks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Prometheus 的 snappy 压缩请求中缺失解码长度验证，允许未认证的攻击者发起内存耗尽攻击。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Misconfigured Samba password scripts pass unescaped client usernames, creating command injection risks in domain controllers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Misconfigured Samba password scripts pass unescaped client usernames, creating command injection risks in domain controllers.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 配置错误的 Samba 密码脚本传递了未转义的客户机用户名，在域控制器中造成命令注入风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Accepting unauthenticated JNDI bind operations in EAP IIOP allows lookup hijacking, enabling MITM attacks or service disruption.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Accepting unauthenticated JNDI bind operations in EAP IIOP allows lookup hijacking, enabling MITM attacks or service disruption.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: EAP IIOP 接受未认证的 JNDI 绑定操作允许查找劫持，从而导致中间人攻击或服务中断。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Direct SQL injection in Firmanet Software ERP allows unauthenticated attackers to extract, modify, or delete sensitive business data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Direct SQL injection in Firmanet Software ERP allows unauthenticated attackers to extract, modify, or delete sensitive business data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Firmanet Software ERP 中的直接 SQL 注入漏洞允许未认证的攻击者提取、修改或删除敏感业务数据。

Other.reason: Type confusion in .NET Core can trigger denial-of-service conditions in managed applications, impacting backend services and cloud-native deployments reliant on the framework.

Other.reason_zh: .NET Core 中的类型混淆漏洞可在托管应用中触发拒绝服务状况，影响依赖该框架的后端服务和云原生部署。

Other.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Account allows remote code execution, targeting a central identity provider used across Microsoft ecosystems.

Other.reason_en: Ansible Core processes unsanitized argument delimiters in role requirements files, allowing malicious authors to inject git configuration flags. This enables credential exfiltration or repository manipulation during automated deployments.

Other.reason: Complete sandbox escape in vm2 allows code to obtain the host Object, breaking Node.js isolation and enabling full system compromise.

Other.reason: Bypass of the module builtin allowlist in vm2 permits loading any Node.js module directly in the host context.
Other.reason_en: Bypass of the module builtin allowlist in vm2 permits loading any Node.js module directly in the host context.
Other.reason_zh: vm2 绕过了模块内置白名单限制，允许在宿主上下文中直接加载任意 Node.js 模块。

Other.reason_en: node-forge incorrectly verifies RSASSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures for low public exponent keys, accepting forged cryptographic proofs.
Other.reason_zh: node-forge 对低公钥指数的密钥错误验证了 RSASSA PKCS#1 v1.5 签名，接受了伪造的密码学证明。

Other.reason: Limiting SysV IPC ID allocation range prevents potential ID reuse issues in Linux checkpoint/restore operations.
Other.reason_en: Limiting SysV IPC ID allocation range prevents potential ID reuse issues in Linux checkpoint/restore operations.
Other.reason_zh: 限制 SysV IPC ID 分配范围可防止 Linux 检查点/恢复操作中潜在的 ID 重用问题。

Other.reason: Invalid LZ4 data triggers uninitialized memory reads, potentially leaking sensitive information from previous decompression operations.
Other.reason_en: Invalid LZ4 data triggers uninitialized memory reads, potentially leaking sensitive information from previous decompression operations.
Other.reason_zh: 无效的 LZ4 数据会触发未初始化内存读取，可能导致泄露先前解压缩操作中的敏感信息。

Other.reason: Crafted tarball member names trigger arbitrary macro expansion during RPM builds, potentially leading to code execution in packaging workflows.
Other.reason_en: Crafted tarball member names trigger arbitrary macro expansion during RPM builds, potentially leading to code execution in packaging workflows.
Other.reason_zh: 构造的 tarball 成员名称会在 RPM 构建期间触发任意宏展开，可能导致打包工作流中发生代码执行。

Other.reason: Specially crafted syslog messages trigger a heap buffer overflow in rsyslog's replace function, risking remote code execution.
Other.reason_en: Specially crafted syslog messages trigger a heap buffer overflow in rsyslog's replace function, risking remote code execution.
Other.reason_zh: 特制的 syslog 消息会触发 rsyslog 替换函数中的堆缓冲区溢出，存在远程代码执行风险。

Other.reason: Uninitialized inode mapping flags cause assertion failures and filesystem corruption in btrfs during cache drops.
Other.reason_en: Uninitialized inode mapping flags cause assertion failures and filesystem corruption in btrfs during cache drops.
Other.reason_zh: 未初始化的 inode 映射标志会在 btrfs 缓存丢弃期间引发断言失败与文件系统损坏。

Other.reason: Truncated SDNV values in NASA's ION-DTN trigger out-of-bounds memory reads, potentially exposing telemetry data in delay-tolerant networks.
Other.reason_en: Truncated SDNV values in NASA's ION-DTN trigger out-of-bounds memory reads, potentially exposing telemetry data in delay-tolerant networks.
Other.reason_zh: NASA ION-DTN 中被截断的 SDNV 值会触发越界内存读取，可能导致延迟容忍网络中的遥测数据泄露。

summary: The daily vulnerability report reveals a high-severity threat environment heavily centered on Microsoft technologies, with critical flaws impacting Windows kernel components, Azure cloud infrastructure, and enterprise services such as SharePoint, Exchange, and Active Directory. Predominant attack vectors include remote code execution, privilege escalation, and insecure deserialization, enabling attackers to gain unauthorized administrative control, bypass identity protections, and compromise virtualized or containerized workloads. Beyond Microsoft products, significant risks affect industrial control systems and IoT devices through command injection and default credential exposure, alongside emerging threats targeting AI integration points and developer environments.

Beyond Microsoft products, significant risks affect industrial control systems and IoT devices through command injection and default credential exposure, alongside emerging threats targeting AI integration points and developer environments.
summary_zh: 每日漏洞报告揭示了一个以微软技术为核心、高危威胁频发的环境，关键缺陷波及 Windows 内核组件、Azure 云基础设施以及 SharePoint、Exchange 和 Active Directory 等企业服务。主要攻击向量包括远程代码执行、权限提升和不安全反序列化，攻击者可借此获取未授权的管理控制权、绕过身份保护机制，并破坏虚拟化或容器化工作负载。除微软产品外，工业控制系统和物联网设备也面临命令注入与默认凭证泄露的重大风险，同时针对 AI 集成节点与开发者环境的新型威胁正不断涌现。
